exposure: mother's own milk (MOM) with bovine milk-based fortifier
Mother's own milk with bovine milk-based fortifier
cohort: Preterm infants consuming either mother's own milk with bovine milk-based fortifier or preterm formula
finding: Feeding preterm infants mother's own milk with bovine milk-based fortifier, compared to preterm formula, was associated with differences in fecal microbiome structure and function, including higher abundance of Actinobacteria, Bifidobacterium, and pathways for fatty acid and carbohydrate degradation.
